mainEntity.name: When should a multi-location business consider implementing AEO strategies?

acceptedAnswer.text: A multi-location business should consider implementing AEO strategies as soon as they aim to improve local visibility, capture more near-me searches, or enhance their presence on voice platforms. This is especially critical if your target audience frequently uses smartphones for local searches or voice assistants for inquiries about local services. Early adoption ensures your business establishes authority and accurate information across all digital touchpoints before competitors. It's also beneficial when expanding to new locations to ensure immediate digital discoverability.
